!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1: Total RNA for proliferating and RS samples (extracted using trizol) and cell pellets for quiescent cells were sent to Azenta. where libraries were prepared using a stranded ribosomal depletion method. The proliferating and RS cells were split across two HiSeq lanes. The quiescent cells were run on one HiSeq lane.
NEBNext® Ultra™ II Directional RNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina®
!Sample_treatment_protocol_ch1: Proliferating cells were harvested at 60 - 80% confluency.
Quiescent cells were obtained by allowing cells to reach 100% confluency and subsequently incubating cells in serum free media for 1-2 days.
Replicative senescent (RS) cells were passaged in regular growth media until replicative exhaustion. These cells were maintained in the senescent state for 3-4 months.
